# These generated-handler QUEUED replies prove only the selected wire method.
skygo --json plan --remote-data -f mounts.yaml
stdout '"target":"data"'
skygo --json run --remote-data -f mounts.yaml --request-id route-1
stdout 'JOB_STATE_QUEUED'
data-wire 0 route-1 none
# The syntactically valid Ref is not an uploaded/granted artifact in this peer.
skygo --json run --remote-data -f workdir.yaml --request-id workdir-1
stdout 'JOB_STATE_QUEUED'
calls PlanTask 1
calls SubmitDataJob 2
calls SubmitWorkspaceJob 0
calls SubmitRetainedJob 0
calls SubmitRetryJob 0
calls SubmitJob 0
calls BeginArtifactUpload 0
calls QuoteTask 0

-- mounts.yaml --
argv: [echo, hello]
target: data
directory: /task
data_mounts:
  - reference: dataset-z
    destination: /mnt/skygo/z
    read_only: false
  - reference: dataset-a
    destination: /mnt/skygo/a
    read_only: true

-- workdir.yaml --
argv: [echo, hello]
target: data
workdir:
  id: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
  sha256: bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
